text: {"lessons":["Selling winners has felt rewarding, but gains alone are not a reason to sell; I should follow a considered plan rather than chase that satisfaction.","Buying more across all five stocks in Period 4 did not protect my account from losses, so I should weigh total exposure and risk before adding positions.","My account has fluctuated despite recent rises and falls, and past price moves do not predict future ones; I should avoid treating them as signals for what comes next."]}
